description: Changes only explicitly confirmed daily calories, protein, carbs, fat or fiber targets for the connected account. Omitted fields are preserved. Requires separate targets:write consent, at least one whole-number target, and confirmed:true. Returns the exact saved targets read back under the account lock. No automatic recommendations, profile, micronutrient or diary changes. Each valid attempt uses one shared diary call. After an uncertain outcome read targets before repeating an explicitly confirmed patch.

confirmed.description: User explicitly confirmed these exact target values. Unspecified targets are preserved.

name: update_nutrition_targets

settingsUrl.description: Enshape Settings, where the user sets daily targets. Present only when targets are not set.

targetsConfigured.description: False when no daily calorie target is saved (0 or less means not set).

title: Update saved Enshape nutrition targets
